scripts.verify:clause: bun run verify:clause-source && bun run build:clause-runtime && bun scripts/verify-clause-pin.ts
scripts.build:clause-runtime: cargo build --manifest-path vendor/clause/Cargo.toml --package clause-runtime --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --locked --target-dir build/clause-target -j 2 && wasm-bindgen build/clause-target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/clause_runtime.wasm --target web --out-dir build/clause-wasm
